two_part_decomposition.part_i_signed_A_inv: Family-specific ambiguity. Requires C_f @ A^{-1} >= 0 for each family. More families -> more constraints -> smaller feasible A set -> diameter shrinks with m. Measured M2 decreasing: 0.516 (m=2) -> 0.443 (m=10). CONFIRMED.
two_part_decomposition.part_ii_nonneg_A_inv: Common confusion (G^0). A = S^{-1} for column-stochastic S. C_f @ S >= 0 automatically (both C_f and S non-negative). Diameter = max(pi, 1-pi) = 1-eta, CONSTANT across m. l1-floor 2*eta is satisfied. CONFIRMED.

summary.check_a_verdict: CONFIRMED: G^0 diameter is constant across all m (mean max_delta = 0.6957 for all m). l1-floor 2*eta = 0.6019 <= l1-diameter = 1.3914. Proposition F1 holds.
summary.check_b_norm: M2 uses half-l1 (max|pi'-pi|). the analytic 2*eta floor in l1 = eta in M2 units. G^0 max_delta = 1 - eta = 0.6990 >= eta = 0.3010. Floor satisfied.
summary.corollary_1_interpretation: E3 empirically demonstrates both parts of Corollary 1: (i) Signed A^{-1} part shrinks with m (M2: 0.516->0.443), (ii) G^0 non-negative part is m-free (constant 1-eta), with explicit l1-floor 2*eta.
